reuse.why: Introduces one assertBankAccountNotLinked check reused by every provider link handler; it leaves the five copy-pasted link functions as they are rather than consolidating them, which is acceptable for this request.

duplication.why: The rule's query and error live once; only the five-line call is repeated in each of the five provider link functions.

placement.why: The check sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers, though accounts/link.ts already holds the shared link-time helpers (findOrCreateBank) and would be the more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its calls at the top of each link function, and a dedicated test file.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear; the provider is a loose string rather than AccountSyncSource and a new provider must remember to call the guard.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link handlers call the new guard before findOrCreateBank; nothing goes around existing abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; repeated call sites are plain invocations of the one helper.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts is the single definition called at the start of linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
